title: Last bell
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, old brick adult night school after dark, flickering fluorescent classrooms and long empty hallways, chalk dust in the air, sickly green and sodium orange tones, adults only, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. Somebody always has to cover. 🔔

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Carla stayed late, the clock ran backwards, and Mr. Grey arrived to keep her after class.
scenes.image: a man in a grey suit in a dark classroom doorway, chalk dust in the air

scenes.narration: Up close, he didn't look like a monster. He looked tired. Like a man at the end of a very long shift.
scenes.image: close-up of a weary pale man in a grey suit, dark circles under his eyes, fluorescent light

scenes.narration: Somebody has to cover, he said. Teachers get sick. Teachers quit. Teachers disappear. And the class still has to go on.
scenes.image: a man in grey sitting on the edge of a teacher's desk, turning a stick of chalk in his fingers

scenes.narration: Where are my students? He nodded at the window. They passed. They're in the old photographs now. Look closer next time.
scenes.image: old cars in a foggy parking lot at night, faint figures sitting inside them

scenes.narration: Then a bell rang. A brass bell this building hadn't had in thirty years.
scenes.image: an old brass school bell mounted on a hallway wall, vibrating, dust shaking loose

scenes.narration: He held out a stick of grey chalk. Your turn to cover, Miss Dunn. I'm finally off the clock.
scenes.image: a pale hand holding out a single stick of grey chalk toward the camera

scenes.narration: She didn't mean to take it. Her fingers just closed. And Mr. Grey smiled, and faded, and blew away like dust off an eraser.
scenes.image: a man in a grey suit dissolving into drifting chalk dust in a dark classroom

scenes.narration: Monday morning, the office had no record of a Carla Dunn. Her parking spot was empty. Her students didn't remember her at all.
scenes.image: an empty teacher's desk in a bright morning classroom, a single stick of grey chalk on it

scenes.narration: But in the basement archive, the nineteen forty staff photo has changed. Back row, far left. A young woman in a grey dress. Holding chalk. Smiling.
scenes.image: a sepia staff portrait of adult teachers, a young woman in a grey dress at the far edge in sharper focus

scenes.narration: Tomorrow night, a new series. A winter caretaker. An empty summer camp. And smoke rising from cabin seven.
scenes.image: a snow-buried log cabin in a dark pine forest with grey smoke rising from its chimney
